odātavasana: [odāta + vasana] (ti) CL=7 One who wears white clothes. (A) One who wears white garments. One who wears the white clothes of a layperson.
odātavattha: [odāta + vattha] (na) CL=7 (1) A white cloth. (A garment for a person). (2) A white and clean cloth. (Ti) (3) One who wears white clothes. (A layperson).
odātavatthadhātu: [odāta + vattha + dhātu] (thī, pu) CL=7 A white cloth. A white element. (gem, dhātu, etc.,).
odātavatthanivattha: [odātavattha + nivattha] (ti) CL=7 Wears white clothes. Has white clothes. One who wears white clothes. (One who wears clothes of a layperson).
odātavatthanivāsita: [odātavattha + nivāsita] (ti) CL=7 Wears white clothes. With white clothes. One who wears white cloth and changes to be a layperson.
odātavatthaparidahana: [odātavattha + paridahana] (ti) CL=7 One who wears white clothes. See - Odātavasana.
odātavatthapharaṇa: [odātavattha + pharaṇa] (na) CL=7 Spreading with white clothes.
odātavatthavasana: [odātavattha + vasana] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who wears white clothes. (2) One who wears clean clothes.
odātavatthavasanaka: [odātavattha + vasana + ka] (ti) CL=7 One who wears white clothes.
odātavaṇṇa: [odāta + vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 One whose appearance is white in color. See - Odātanidassana.
odātaṭṭhāna: [odāta + ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A white place or a pure region.
odātālaṅkāra: [odāta + alaṅkāra] (ta) CL=7 One who has white ornaments.
odahisu: [ava + dhā + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 (1) They paid attention. They listened carefully. They set a snare. See - Odahati (1). (2) They placed into. They inserted. They caused to enter. See - Odahati (2).
odanasasaṭṭha: [odana + saṃsaṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 Rice - Mixed with rice.
